sections.content: Scale CSS with methodology: BEM naming (.block__element--modifier), utility-first (Tailwind-style single-purpose classes), or CSS modules/component-scoped styles.
Whatever you choose: one file per component, tokens for repeated values, and delete dead CSS — specificity wars come from accumulation.
Key points: style guide beats personal taste, custom properties for theming, and lint tools catch unused/broken rules.
